title: Clawd X Digest
summary: Voice Agent API Rollout: xAI launches its no-code Voice Agent Builder with Grok Voice, priced competitively at $0.05 per minute to target developers.

Claude Fable 5 Performance: Claude Fable 5 achieves a leading 16.10% success rate on the Remote Labor Index for real freelance projects, displaying superior physics simulation capability despite higher token costs.
OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol Rumors: Reports circulate that OpenAI is targeting a July 7th launch date for GPT-5.6 Sol, which is already in limited gray rollout.
SEC Rule S7-2026-15 Controversy: Financial advocates push back against a proposed SEC rule change allowing public companies to report financials semiannually, raising concerns about transparency.

World Cup Action & Records: Harry Kane reaches 72 goals for club and country this season—second only to Lionel Messi's 2011/12 record—while Lukaku's leadership inspires a dramatic 3-2 comeback for Belgium over Senegal.

items.title: @xai: No-Code Voice Agent Builder Launched
items.body: xAI launches a no-code developer platform to create human-like voice agents using Grok Voice, priced competitively at $0.05 per minute.

items.title: @kimmonismus: Claude Fable 5 Dominates Freelance Benchmarks
items.body: Claude Fable 5 reaches a new milestone of 16.10% on the Remote Labor Index, which tests AI on real remote freelance projects across 23 domains. This represents a doubling of the performance of the next closest model.

items.title: @pankajkumar_dev: OpenAI Targets July 7th GPT-5.6 Sol Release
items.body: Reports indicate OpenAI is targeting July 7th for the global launch of GPT-5.6 Sol, which is already undergoing a limited gray rollout to select users.

items.title: @atomic_chat_hq: Fable 5 Physics Simulation Costs and Quality
items.body: A detailed benchmark of Fable 5, GPT 5.5, Opus 4.8, and GLM 5.2 on HTML5 canvas physics simulations shows Fable 5 achieves perfect fidelity but consumes 6x more tokens than Opus 4.8.

items.title: @leerob: Kimi K2.7 Now Available in Cursor
items.body: Vercel's VP of Product Lee Robinson shares evaluations of the newly integrated Kimi K2.7 model in Cursor, comparing its performance directly against GLM 5.2.

items.title: @GitHub_Daily: Archify Agent Skill Generates Technical Diagrams
items.body: Introduces Archify, a CLI and editor-integrated Agent skill that converts natural language text descriptions into self-contained HTML and high-resolution PNG architecture diagrams.

items.title: @keepitquarterly: Public Feedback Closes on SEC Rule S7-2026-15
items.body: Advocates warn that the proposed SEC Rule S7-2026-15, which allows public companies to report financials semiannually rather than quarterly, could enable corporate insiders to front-run retail investors before disclosures.

items.title: @WatcherGuru: US June Unemployment and Job Growth Below Expectations
items.body: The US economy added 57,000 jobs in June, coming in below economic forecasts, while the overall unemployment rate fell slightly to 4.2%.

items.title: @433: Real Madrid Secures €95M from Non-Squad Player Sales
items.body: Real Madrid closes in on €95M in revenue from academy players, including a €12.5M windfall from a 50% sell-on clause for Álvaro Rodríguez's €25M transfer from Elche to Bournemouth.

items.title: @shirish: Perplexity Traffic and Market Share Plummet
items.body: Data reveals Perplexity's US daily active user share dropped 65% over five months, falling from 6% to 2% as Gemini and ChatGPT capture over 56% of global AI search traffic.

items.title: @Oliviacoder1: Finding Untouched Costco Executive Cashback Balances
items.body: A viral thread highlights how Costco Executive members frequently leave hundreds or thousands of dollars in cashback checks unclaimed due to a lack of awareness of member portal rewards.

items.title: @brfutboll: Harry Kane Rejects Old Age Excuses
items.body: Asked about being the oldest player on the pitch for England's match, Harry Kane laughed off age limitations by noting that Lionel Messi is still the world's best at 39.

items.title: @433: Harry Kane Hits 72 Goals for Club and Country
items.body: With 72 goals scored for club and country this season, Harry Kane records the second-highest single-season goal tally of the 21st century, surpassed only by Lionel Messi's legendary 2011/12 campaign.

items.title: @_su6an: Lukaku's Leadership Sparks Belgium's World Cup Win
items.body: Belgian striker Romelu Lukaku is praised for diffusing a team argument on the pitch while down 2-0 to Senegal, scoring the opening goal, and rallying Belgium to an epic 3-2 victory.

items.title: @yantanzhang: Leadership Transition Challenges in Chinese Legacies
items.body: Highlights business hurdles in second-generation leadership transitions, citing the short-lived 'Wa Xiao Zong' brand under Kelly Zong at WahaHa and product naming disruptions at Great Wall Motor.

items.title: @WrittenBy_SS: Electrician's Haunted Motion Sensor Discovery
items.body: A humorous story of home buyers apologizing to previous owners after spending $2,000 to fix a 'haunted' hallway light, only to discover a faulty motion sensor was triggering the system.
